title: Chapter 415 - 415 Mission; Become A Teacher!

Chapter 415 - 415 Mission; Become A Teacher!

Chapter 415 - 415 Mission; Become a Teacher!

415 Mission; Become a Teacher!

The next day.

Even though she was tired from last night, Han Tian still made lean meat noodles, fried dumplings, and eggs early in the morning.

Then, she made two cups of hot milk.

Lin Fan and Han Tian fed each other and kept laughing. It was very sweet.

After the meal, Han Tian went to Lianjia’s branch office while Lin Fan went to Jiangbei University.

At this moment, two more bright banners appeared in front of the gate of Jiangbei University.

[We warmly congratulate our school’s Lin Fan on publishing his thesis on the cover of Nature!]

[Warm congratulations to our school’s Lin Fan for his invention of the super battery!]

Every once in a while, Jiangbei University would hang a new banner about Lin Fan.

Now that there were two more, Lin Fan was no longer surprised.

After Lin Fan parked the car, he went straight to the classroom.

Song Yi, who was sitting at the back, waved his hand and shouted, “Brother Lin Fan, over here!”

“Brother Lin Fan, did you invent the super battery again?” Zheng Jinbao asked.

When the students who were chatting in low voices heard this, they all looked at Lin Fan.

Obviously, they were also very curious about this.

Lin Fan nodded. “Yeah.”

Zheng Jinbao immediately raised his thumb and praised, “Brother Lin Fan, you’re awesome!”

All the students also revealed looks of admiration.

At this moment, the bell rang.

The old professor walked in slowly with his textbook.

He cleared his throat and began his new lesson.

After he spoke, Lin Fan seemed to have heard a lullaby and fell into a deep sleep.

Seeing this…

The old professor could not help but nod his head repeatedly. Geniuses were indeed made of 99% sweat. Even though he had already obtained so many achievements, Lin Fan probably studied hard again last night.

He must not disturb his sleep!

Thus, the old professor shut his mouth, turned around, and wrote a few big words on the blackboard—’Quiet self-study, no talking. Violators will be punished with 0 points at the end of the semester!’

The entire classroom immediately fell silent.

There was only a series of loud snores.

The crisp bell rang. Lin Fan slowly opened his eyes. There was a little more noise in the classroom.

At this moment, Counselor Sun Yaodong walked in.

He looked up, and when he saw Lin Fan, his eyes lit up. He smiled and said, “I’ve always said that I have good taste. Lin Fan has brought glory to our class again. Good, very good!”

He had brought glory to the class again.

Lin Fan rolled his eyes.

“Lin Fan, Chancellor Shen Liang wants you to go to his office.”

“Alright,” Lin Fan replied.

Most students did not know how to get to the chancellor’s office even after many years of studying.

However, Lin Fan was very familiar with the place.

Chancellor Shen Liang seemed to have been waiting for Lin Fan. When Lin Fan came to the door, he quickly went up to him and said happily, “Lin Fan, you’re here? Hurry up and sit inside!”

Then, Shen Liang personally poured a cup of fragrant tea for Lin Fan.

A dignified chancellor was welcoming him at the door and pouring him tea…

One had to admit that he really cared about Lin Fan.

Then, they chatted, and the chancellor showed concern.

Lin Fan sat on the soft sofa and drank the tea. He would reply to the chancellor from time to time, but he felt bored.

Shen Liang seemed to have noticed that Lin Fan was getting impatient.

Thus, he cleared his throat and said the reason why he had invited Lin Fan over.

“Lin Fan, first of all, on behalf of the school, the country, and the world, please allow me to express my sincere gratitude to you for solving Zhou’s Conjecture, the Twin Prime Number Conjecture, the Hail Conjecture, the Hodge Conjecture, and other mathematical problems, as well as for your invention of the super battery, the earthquake prediction device, the human islet recovery medicine, the carbon-based photolithographic machine, the super battery, and other products that benefit mankind!”

After Shen Liang finished speaking, he stood up and bowed deeply toward Lin Fan.

His words were extremely sincere without any pretense.

Lin Fan said, “This is just a small matter. Chancellor, you don’t have to do this.”

“No!” Shen Liang said righteously. “This is what I should do!”

“Lin Fan, I know you’re a very thoughtful person and don’t like to be restrained.

“However, I still want to ask if you can take a few mentors under your wing?

“Honestly, I feel that it would be a waste if your wisdom can’t be passed down.

“Of course, don’t worry. You only need to give them some guidance when you have time. Most of the time, you can hand them over to other associate professors.”

In reality, Shen Liang had such thoughts since long ago.

However, just as he said, he knew that Lin Fan did not like to be restrained.

Therefore, he had never mentioned it before.

However, Shen Liang recently found out that the Institute of Science really wanted Lin Fan to go over.

This gave Shen Liang a sense of urgency.

After all, there was no comparison between Jiangbei University and the Institute of Science.

What if Lin Fan really went over?

The glory that Jiangbei University had enjoyed during this period of time would soon be gone.

However, if Lin Fan had some mentors here, then it would be different.

….

Mentor students?

The assistant professors would help?

Lin Fan was stunned.

He was about to speak.

At this moment, a clear notification sounded in his mind.

[Ding! Mission: Become a teacher. Teach five students and let them receive a total of three international awards. Reward: Five golden red packets and a special skill.]

Five golden red packets and a special skill!

It had been a long time since he received a skill.

“Alright,” Lin Fan replied immediately.

“Huh?”

When Shen Liang heard Lin Fan’s reply, he was stunned.

He had prepared many excuses.

He was even prepared to be rejected by Lin Fan.

What was the situation now?

Lin Fan immediately agreed?

He could hardly believe his ears.

Lin Fan saw that Shen Liang did not reply for a long time and could not help but say, “Why? Can’t I?”

Shen Liang hurriedly said, “No, no. Of course, you can!”

Then, Shen Liang said, “Lin Fan, which subject do you want to teach? Computer? Chemistry? Creatures? Or mathematics?”

Lin Fan thought for a while and said, “I’ll teach them a little of each subject.”

After all, Lin Fan needed five students to receive three international awards.

Teaching them different subjects would give them a higher chance of winning.

Teaching a few students each subject?

If it was someone else who said this, they would definitely be spat on.

After all, everyone’s focus was different. How could the students be taught different subjects?

However, Lin Fan was different!

He had achieved amazing results in mathematics, chemistry, physics, biology, and computer science!

He was a big shot among big shots!

He was willing to teach students different disciplines, and Shen Liang could not be happier. How could he object?
